definitions.explanation: An organized group that travels to unfamiliar or remote areas for the purpose of exploration, research, or discovery.

examples.japanese: {探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧{探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えた→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: The Antarctic expedition endured severe cold.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦ごっこ→ごっこ：09095_gokko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing expedition in the forest.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ (exploration) + ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (team; squad). Used both for serious historical and scientific expeditions and playfully for children's adventure games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: form an expedition
- {探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: dispatch an expedition
- {探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: join an expedition
- {探検隊|たんけんたい}⟦ごっこ→ごっこ：09095_gokko⟧: playing expedition (children's game)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調査隊|ちょうさたい}: survey team — focuses on research and data collection rather than discovery
- ⟦{遠征隊|えんせいたい}→遠征隊：25462_enseitai⟧: expeditionary force — can imply a military component
- ⟦{冒険家|ぼうけんか}→冒険家：20564_boukenka⟧: adventurer — an individual rather than a group
